verdict.rationale: DeepInfra documents deploying your own fine-tuned LLM weights on dedicated A100–B300 instances with autoscaling and a private endpoint, so serving a fine-tune on the platform is covered. For training, the only option is renting B200/B300 GPU clusters with SSH and running your own workflow; no managed fine-tuning service for supported base models is evidenced. Missing for 10: managed fine-tuning API/workflow on catalog base models, data upload/training job docs, a documented train-to-deploy handoff, independent or hands-on corroboration.
